The saereconciliation.sas program has two major components: First, reconciling the SAE vendor’s Pharmacovigilance safety database, in Excel format in this example, with a SAS dataset from the clinical database containing the Adverse Event data. This paper presents a SAS-based approach to identify and handle data issues using data visualizations, macros, and efficient data cleaning techniques.
